property: tcpdump consumes the libpcap-style portable capture/filter interface and adds protocol dissection plus operator-facing rendering of packet fields and assigned numbers.

sources.supports: libpcap capture/filter role in the tcpdump tool family

negative_claims: tcpdump is not the same artifact as libpcap or BPF.
Protocol names printed by a dissector do not establish registry authority; dissector tables must be cross-checked with authoritative registries.
open_questions: Acquire oldest tcpdump distributions and map pre-libpcap capture interfaces.
